title: Drive: Versioning, Sync, and Collaboration
description: Add file versioning, delta sync, and real-time collaboration.

data.text: Add file versioning so edits create new versions without overwriting, delta sync to reduce bandwidth, and real-time collaboration with conflict resolution.

data.title: FileVersion and SyncEngine
Operational Transform
data.text: For real-time collaboration, use Operational Transform (OT) or CRDTs. OT transforms concurrent edits into a consistent order. CRDTs converge without coordination.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: SyncEngine compares hashes to detect changes
Delta sync transfers only changed bytes
Collaboration needs OT or CRDT for conflict resolution
data.takeaway: Drive is a versioned tree with sync. Versioning is append-only. Sync is hash-based. Collaboration is the hardest part and needs distributed consensus.
